evidence.quote: not books.Books.Customers.IsEmpty || not books.Books.Drafts.IsEmpty || not books.Books.Invoices.IsEmpty || not books.Payments.IsEmpty
| Some n, _, _, _ when n <> Version -> Error $"Transfer files of version {n} cannot be read here."

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The new rules are the import-only-into-new-books guard, the refusal order, the version check, the data-version match, and the GitHub and no-files-pack refusals. All of them are in Tier 2 code (`Summa.Storage.Transfer` and the `Summa.Web.Engine` `apply` function). The only Tier 3 change is mapping three kernel event names to messages, so Tier 3 decides nothing.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: The change adds no clock, randomness, I/O or console access in Tier 1/2. The export time comes in as `ctx.Now`, and the business date comes from `businessToday model ctx`. The download is requested as data (`OfferDownload(name, "application/json", ...)`) and the save goes through the existing `save` helper, which emits a `SaveBooks` effect. `Transfer.fs` is pure and uses `System.Text.Json` for serialization. That is not an effect in this rubric's sense, but it would trip the separate ARC-SYM-01 symbol rule.

ARC-REV-03.rationale: Each fact has one definition. `Schema` and `Version` are literals in `Transfer.fs`, and the data version comes from `Exports.dataVersion`. The classification comes from `Exports.Classification`, the snapshot from `LocalSnapshot.encode`, and the `notATransferFile` sentence is a single private value. The existing download-refusal sentence is reused. The one possible repeat is the `yyyy-MM-dd` format, which is a presentation format applied in two places in the engine.

evidence.quote: Error "The books in this file do not match its contents."
let customers, invoices, payments = Transfer.counts t.Books

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The contents-versus-books check and the version acceptance live in Tier 2 `Transfer.read`. The preview is built in the Tier 2 view projection by calling `Transfer.read` and `Transfer.counts`. Tier 3 and Tier 4 are not changed except for the HTML binding.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: The change adds no effects. The preview is a pure projection of the model's pasted text through the pure `Transfer.read`. No clock, I/O or other port access is added.

evidence.quote: | Some n, _, _, _ when n <> 1 && n <> Version -> Error $"Transfer files of version {n} cannot be read here."
if version = Some 2 && contents <> Some(counts restored.Books) then

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The counts have one definition, `Transfer.counts`, which export, read and the view all use. The supported-version facts are restated as bare literals: `1` in the accepted-version check and `Some 2` in the contents check, alongside the `Version = 2` literal. The copies currently agree, but a later version bump would need all three updated together.
